panels.visual: Aristotle (dandy, rings, fashionable hair) at Plato's Academy with a scroll, a bench of students, a clock showing twenty years
panels.caption: Aristotle studied at Plato's Academy for about twenty years.

panels.visual: Aristotle tutoring a boy, the young Alexander the Great, with a map of the world
panels.caption: He tutored the young Alexander the Great.

panels.visual: Aristotle walking and talking under covered walkways of the Lyceum, a bunch of students struggling to keep up, out of breath
panels.caption: People say he taught while walking. His followers were called Peripatetics, the walkers-about.

panels.visual: Builders in 1996 digging a foundation and finding ancient ruins, an excited archaeologist, a modern crane behind
panels.caption: The ruins of the Lyceum were only found in 1996, when builders dug for a new museum.
